component.name: quiver
component.summary: Fast and responsive image viewer and photo manager

description.p: Quiver is a high-performance image viewer and manager built for the GNOME desktop using GTK4. It focuses on speed, responsiveness, and seamless navigation across large photo collections.

ul.li: Fast thumbnail browsing and asynchronous caching
Video playback support with smooth seek and timeline controls
EXIF and IPTC metadata viewing and date adjustments
Tagging, bookmarking, and external tool integration
Fluid animations and modern GTK4 interface

description.p: GTK4 migration, smooth play/pause animations, responsive thumbnail browsing, and modern C++20 codebase.
